title: Cloudflare Adds Configurable HTTP Vary Header Support to Prevent Cache Thrashing
gist: Cloudflare added native, configurable HTTP Vary support in Cache Rules on all plans, letting operators normalise, pass through or bypass request headers to avoid cache fragmentation, after an audit found nearly 3,000 of ~50,000 top domains varying on four or more headers.

insights.claim: CDNs have historically treated the HTTP Vary header cautiously because minor client header differences such as whitespace, casing or language ordering can splinter one resource into dozens of cache variants.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Explains why content negotiation has hurt CDN cache efficiency and origin load.

insights.claim: In an audit of over 120 million HTTP responses across about 50,000 top domains, Cloudflare found nearly 3,000 origins varied on four or more request headers, some across dozens of fields.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Quantifies the scale of cache-unfriendly behaviour, a target for CDN product differentiation.

insights.claim: Uncontrolled header variance causes cache thrashing, collapsing hit ratios and escalating origin load.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Better cache hit ratios reduce customer origin costs, strengthening CDN value proposition.

insights.claim: Cloudflare splits negotiation into two stages: origins declare which request headers matter, while Cache Rules decide how the edge normalises, passes through or ignores those values before computing the variant key.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Operator control over caching semantics is a competitive feature for CDNs.

insights.claim: Cache Rules offer three Vary actions: normalise canonicalises headers like Accept and Accept-Language, pass through stores exact case-sensitive strings, and bypass skips edge caching for volatile or high-cardinality headers.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Granular controls enable broader caching of personalised and localised content.

insights.claim: Unlike custom cache keys that evaluate upfront even for invariant responses, Vary rules trigger only when the origin returns a Vary header, avoiding needless key-space expansion.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Reduces wasted cache capacity, improving CDN unit economics.

insights.claim: Previously teams had to disable caching, use Cloudflare Workers, maintain brittle custom cache keys, or use extensions like Vary for Images.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Native support may reduce Workers usage for caching workarounds while lowering adoption friction.

insights.claim: Operators must assess cache key cardinality before passing through high-entropy headers, since each distinct value such as a session identifier creates an isolated edge entry and increases eviction churn.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Misconfiguration risk can still erode cache efficiency.
insights.locator: While the new mechanism reduces implementation

insights.claim: Vary support in Cache Rules is available on all Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise zones.
insights.speaker: Olimpiu Pop
insights.so_what: Broad availability across tiers increases platform stickiness.
insights.locator: While the new mechanism reduces implementation
